title: Similar Scores, Opposite Failures: Human Correction as an Instrument for Video Caption Evaluation
summary: Reference-overlap metrics poorly distinguish accepted from rejected captions (BLEU-4 AUC 0.510); window-level review detects more camera/shot errors than overview review. Six models, 196 clips, and human post-edits under overview/window protocols provide the reference; one annotator per caption and this corpus/prompt bound generalization.
